verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains no AI-training opt-out, no no-training policy, and no statement about how customer data is used for model training. Sensitive-data redaction, the self-hosted On-premise edition, and event discard rules are related data-control features, but they are not a documented guarantee or setting that prevents data from being used to train AI models.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
